Maya (Marketing Ops): Quick heads-up: this morning ~15 inbound leads showed as unassigned because enrichment didn't populate `company_enriched` before the claim window closed. Noticed a spike between 09:12-09:18 PT.

Theo (Sales Ops): That's causing leads to fall into the generic fallback and not hitting reps. Any pattern on payload size or specific sources?

Maya (Marketing Ops): Preliminary: 60% from webinar signup forms (large payloads with attachments), 40% from API intake. Logs show enrichment service is returning 202 then delayed PATCH to HS. Example logs: `PATCH /hubspot/lead/701 status=202 delay=9.8s`

Ravi (Platform Eng): Current routing behavior: claim window = 4s. If `company_enriched` not present -> RR logic skips and fallback owner is used. Two options: lengthen claim window OR perform optimistic assign then reassign after enrichment.

Nora (Growth): I prefer reassign approach to keep SLA for initial notification (so reps see the lead immediately) but correct ownership once enrichment completes.

Theo (Sales Ops): Reassigning is fine, but need to make sure reps don't get duplicate notifications or angry that leads get assigned away. Can we mark as `staged` and include a note?

Ravi (Platform Eng): Proposed change:
```
# leadflow settings
CLAIM_WINDOW_MS=8000
OPTIMISTIC_ASSIGN=true
OPTIMISTIC_OWNER=Unverified-Temp
ANNOTATE_ON_REASSIGN=true
```
Behavior: attempt optimistic assign to Unverified-Temp immediately, still wait up to 8s for enrichment. If enrichment hits and RR computes a rep -> reassign and post comment: "Auto-reassigned after enrichment: previous owner Unverified-Temp."

Maya (Marketing Ops): Sounds reasonable. Can we also add a metric tag `owner_temp` so Sales can filter these leads?

Ravi (Platform Eng): Yes, will add lead property `temp_owner_flag=true` and emit metric `lead.assigned.temporary`.

Theo (Sales Ops): For SFDC, will add assignment rule that accepts `temp_owner_flag` and routes to `Unverified Queue` but excludes from active outreach lists until reassignment. Also need an alert if more than 5% of daily leads are in temp state.

Nora (Growth): Canary plan: staging run with 500 synthetic leads (20% with large enrichment payloads), measure: `percent_assigned_temp`, `reassign_rate`, `avg_time_to_final_owner`, and `notified_rep_duplicates`.

Maya (Marketing Ops): Timeline request: staging patch at 1:30pm PT; canary between 2:00-3:00pm; if <2% duplicate-notify and reassign rate <12% we go to prod at 8pm PT.

lead-monitor-bot: new deploy queued: leadflow-v2 -> staging (build 911).

Ravi (Platform Eng): I'll own the deploy and monitoring dashboard. Rollback plan: set OPTIMISTIC_ASSIGN=false, CLAIM_WINDOW_MS=4000, clear `temp_owner_flag`. Rollback ETA config in deploy notes.

Theo (Sales Ops): I'll draft the internal notice for Sales leadership explaining `Unverified-Temp` behavior + instructions to ignore leads in that queue until reassigned. Will include sample search filter.

Maya (Marketing Ops): Also adding a one-pager for SDRs: what to do when they see "Auto-reassigned after enrichment" note. Keep it short.

Nora (Growth): Post-canary checklist: link to staging dashboard, sample lead ids (e.g., 701, 734, 852), and a short recording of the test run. Please paste results here.

Ravi (Platform Eng): Will post metrics and Grafana links here after the canary. If anything looks off I'll trigger rollback and ping @here.

Maya (Marketing Ops): Thanks team. Let's keep the rollout conservative but move quickly — this is hitting our SLA numbers in the morning spikes. :rocket:
